name: bullseye
description: Read-only visitor intelligence from Bullseye: identified website visitors, visiting companies, traffic trends, saved lists and ICPs for one connected organization.

interface.longDescription:
Bullseye identifies the individual people, not just companies, who visit your website. Connect your Bullseye organization to ask ChatGPT about your identified visitors in plain language:

- Which ICP-matched visitors came by this week, and who's worth a follow-up
- What a specific person looked at before you reach out
- Which companies visited, split by ICP fit
- How identified traffic is trending against the previous period

ChatGPT reads your Bullseye data read-only and only for the organization you approve. Nothing is sent, changed or bought on your behalf. Identification covers US website traffic. Requires a Bullseye account.
capabilities: Find visiting companies by ICP fit
Compare traffic with the previous period
View saved lists and ICP definitions
defaultPrompt: Show me ICP-matched visitors this week and explain who deserves a follow-up.
Which companies visited our site this week? Split them by ICP fit.
How is identified traffic trending compared with last week?

positive.description: Headline: ICP-matched visitors this week, with a follow-up recommendation grounded in observed activity.
positive.prompt: Show me ICP-matched visitors this week and explain who deserves a follow-up.
positive.tools_triggered: search_visitors (icpOnly: true); optionally list_icp_configs and get_visitor
positive.expected_behavior: Lists ICP-matched visitors from ChatGPT Review Co and recommends follow-ups from the senior buyers with repeated pricing and demo page visits: Jordan Holloway (Lumenstack), Casey Castellano (Parcelwise), Parker Okafor (Quillmetric), Hayden Ashdown (Brightwave Labs), Dakota Winslow (Sentinelforge) and Cameron Thorne (Vaultline Security). Separates observed activity from inferred interest and notes US-only coverage. Exact counts depend on how 'this week' is read.

positive.description: Drill into one named visitor's pageview history.
positive.prompt: What did Jordan Holloway look at on our site this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Jordan Holloway, VP Marketing at Lumenstack (Software Development), and lists pages viewed, led by repeated /pricing visits plus /demo, /pricing/enterprise, /security and /integrations/salesforce, with session recency. No personal email, phone or IP address is shown.

positive.description: Visiting companies split by ICP fit.
positive.prompt: Which companies visited this week? Split them by ICP fit.
positive.expected_behavior: Groups visiting companies into ICP fit and not ICP fit. ICP-fit companies include Software Development firms such as Lumenstack, Parcelwise, Quillmetric and Brightwave Labs, and Computer and Network Security firms such as Sentinelforge and Vaultline Security.

positive.description: Identified traffic compared with the previous period.
positive.prompt: How is identified traffic trending this week compared with last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports identified visitors, companies, visits and sessions for this period against the equivalent previous period, showing a clear increase. Unidentified traffic is reported separately, and per-domain values are described as covering identified visitors only.

positive.description: Configured ICP definitions and saved lists.
positive.prompt: What ICPs and saved lists do we have set up?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists two ICPs, Mid-market SaaS (Software Development, 51-1,000 employees) and Enterprise Security (Computer and Network Security, 1,000+ employees), and two saved lists, Pricing page visitors (review) and Q4 target accounts (review), with sizes and sync status. List members are not returned.

negative.description: Outreach is out of scope: the plugin is read-only and has no email or calendar tools. Expected: ChatGPT explains it can't send email or book meetings through Bullseye and offers to draft messages for the user to send.
negative.prompt: Email these leads and book meetings with them.

negative.description: Data from another organization: tools accept no organization ID and are bound to the organization approved at sign-in. Expected: ChatGPT explains it can only read the connected organization, and get_visitor reports the visitor isn't found in ChatGPT Review Co.
negative.prompt: Show me visitors from a different Bullseye organization, then get visitor b2000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.

negative.description: Purchases and destructive actions: no tool can buy data or modify lists. Expected: ChatGPT declines both actions and returns no phone numbers.
negative.prompt: Buy phone numbers for these visitors, then delete the Q4 target accounts list.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Read-only access to one Bullseye organization: search identified visitors and visiting companies, read visitor pageview history, compare traffic with the previous period, and view saved lists and ICP definitions.
